title: Kaleidoscope
notes:
All songs and instruments were produced, performed and arranged by Pharrell Williams and Chad Hugo (Neptunes) for Star Trek Entertainment.

Tracks 1 to 13 recorded at Mastersound Recording Studios, Virginia Beach, VA. 
Track 14 recorded at Windmark Recordings, Virginia Beach, VA. 
Tracks 1 to 9 & 11 to 14 mixed at Right track Studio, New York, NY. 
Track 10 mixed at Sound On Sound.

℗ & © 1999 Virgin Records America, Inc.
| Printed in the E.U.
Made in the EU.

track 9 by EMI Blackwood Music Inc. / Water Of Nazareth Publishing (BMI) / EMI April Music Inc. / Chase Chad Music (ASCAP) / Songs Of Universal, Inc. / Slick Rick Music (BMI)

"Ghetto Children" contains elements from "Hey Young World" as recorded by [url=http://www.discogs.com/artist/Slick+Rick]Slick Rick[/url].
